title: CRMMapping
description: Declarative mapping from GTM Superintelligence report fields to a CRM's field API names, so coaching/deal/account results can auto-fill any CRM. The mapping is data; the writer (Salesforce/HubSpot/generic/HTTP) is pluggable. This makes CRM writeback vendor-neutral.

objects.description: One entry per CRM object you want to write to.

source.description: Which GTM Superintelligence report this object's fields are drawn from.

id_field.description: Field on the report subject/metadata holding the CRM record id to update (e.g. 'subject.id' or 'metadata.opportunity_id').

fields.description: Field mappings. Each maps a CRM field to a value pulled from the report via a dotted path or template.

crm_field.description: CRM field API name, e.g. 'GTMSI_Score__c' or 'meddpicc_metrics'.

from.description: Dotted path into the report (e.g. 'overall_score', 'classification.call_type', 'risk') OR a {{template}} string referencing such paths.

transform.description: Optional value transform applied before writing.

when_empty.description: What to do if the source value is missing.
